card.name: Words leading into risk or reduction phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words or verbs right before an expected risk or lab-value term, such as "reduce", "associated with", or "reduction in" in dosing and warning sentences.

modes.label: Reduce / reduction
modes.description: The word reduce, or the words after it, just before a named risk or lab value.
modes.example: To<< reduce>> the risk of hHF in patients with

modes.label: Associated with
modes.description: The word "with" after "associated" before an increased-risk statement.
modes.example: for asthma is associated<< with>> an increased risk of asthma-related death.

modes.label: Reduction in
modes.description: The word "in" after "reduction" before a lab measure like LDL-C.
modes.example: Patients who require reduction<< in>> LDL-C greater than 45%
